scope: R9 restrained articulation and one slight head tip in existing 21-second opening. User rejected pronounced mouth motion and head shake on the admission.

params.prompt:
Make this existing selfie performance quieter and more natural while preserving the person, glasses, olive overshirt, home, camera framing, speech, voice and timing. Keep articulation clear but compact: relaxed jaw, smaller mouth openings, soft ordinary lip movements, no exaggerated enunciation or stretched mouth corners.

During 'I've gotta get better at that' (about4–5.2seconds), remove the side-to-side head shake. Keep his face close to the lens. Near the end of the line, use just one slight tip of the head, a small incline toward one shoulder of only a few degrees, then gently return to level. It should feel like a passing acknowledgement, not a choreographed gesture. No repeated nodding or lateral head motion.

Keep a relaxed, attentive expression with natural blinking. Let the line land plainly. No deliberate grin, smirk, cheek lift or eyebrow flourish. Continue into 'With AI' with the head settled and the same restrained mouth movement. Keep the measured GTM explanation and all existing speech unchanged.

finishing_decision: Analyze returned native speech against unchanged R7 voice before deciding whether any additional lip-sync synthesis is needed.
